name: Otter.ai MCP
description: Searches and fetches your Otter.ai meeting transcripts from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Perplexity, so you can summarize meetings and pull past decisions without copy-paste.

skills.name: Meeting Search
skills.description: Searches meetings you captured in Otter or that teammates shared with you, and returns an overview of the matching conversations.

skills.name: Transcript Fetch
skills.description: Retrieves the full speech transcript of a meeting or conversation, including from a shared Otter conversation URL, for summaries and analysis.

skills.name: User Info
skills.description: Returns the authenticated Otter user's name and email address, so the assistant knows whose meetings and conversations it is reading.
